name: pr-reviewer
description: AI-powered code reviewer CLI using GitHub Copilot API

scripts.build:azdo-task: mkdir -p azure-devops/task && cp dist/azure-pipelines-task.js azure-devops/task/ && cp dist/index.js azure-devops/task/ && cp -r dist/azure-devops azure-devops/task/ && cp -r dist/github azure-devops/task/ && cp -r dist/review azure-devops/task/ && cp -r dist/types azure-devops/task/ && cp package.json azure-devops/task/ && cd azure-devops/task && npm install --production
scripts.package:azdo: npm run build && cd azure-devops && tfx extension create --manifest-globs vss-extension.json
